bagPolicy.summary: Personal bags must be smaller than 12 × 12 × 12 inches and are searched. Backpacks are prohibited, with parenting, diaper, and medical bags allowed.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is first come, first served, prices vary by event, and cash is not accepted. The venue lists Lot 22 for Gates A and B and Lot 6 for Gate C and the club; arrive early for concerts.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare zone in its arena guide.

concessions.summary: Arena-managed concessions are cashless, with mobile ordering at select stands; the venue allows one empty plastic water bottle for refilling. Metal and glass bottles and outside beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is available in every lot with an official placard; the venue asks for two weeks’ notice to arrange an ASL interpreter for a concert. The guest elevator is inside Gate D lobby.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is generally prohibited; guests seeking an emergency exception should visit Guest Services in the Gate A lobby.

ticketPickup.summary: The ticket office is at Gate A on the southwest corner and opens three hours before ticketed concert showtime; tickets are mobile only. The page does not specify a distinct will-call process.
